questions.stem: What is the source of energy released in both fission and fusion reactions?

options.text: The kinetic energy of the neutrons
A small amount of mass is converted to energy according to E = mc squared

questions.explanation: In both fission and fusion, the total mass of the products is slightly less than the total mass of the reactants. This 'missing' mass (called the mass defect) has been converted into energy according to Einstein's equation E = mc squared. Because the speed of light squared is an enormous number, even a tiny mass loss releases a huge amount of energy.
